name: 39th ECNP Congress 2026
venue: ICM International Congress Center Messe Muenchen
description: The 39th ECNP Congress takes place October 10 to 13, 2026, at the ICM in Munich. Abstract submission closed May 7, 2026, with no late breaking track, and standard fee registration remains open until October 9, 2026.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission
deadlines.note: 10:00 CEST; no late breaking abstracts; not extended; closed

deadlines.label: Onsite registration closes
deadlines.note: 13:00 CEST; virtual registration follows the same closing time

sources.note: Abstract deadline May 7, 2026, notification July 15, presenter registration July 22, poster upload September 8
Early fee until May 20, standard until October 9, onsite until October 13, 2026
Dates, city and venue for 2026 and 2027 congresses

notes: ECNP Excellence Awards exist for early career scientists but their deadline was not visible on the pages reviewed. Livestreamed sessions remain available to registrants until January 11, 2027.

name: 40th ECNP Congress 2027
description: The 40th ECNP Congress is scheduled for September 25 to 28, 2027, at the CCIB in Barcelona. No abstract or registration deadlines have been published; the 2027 congress website is a placeholder as of September 2026.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission
deadlines.note: estimated from the 2026 cycle (May 7, 2026, about five months before the congress); the 2027 congress is two weeks earlier

deadlines.label: Early fee registration
deadlines.note: estimated from the 2026 cycle (May 20, 2026); not published

sources.note: 40th ECNP Congress September 25 to 28, 2027, Barcelona, CCIB
Lists the 2027 congress dates without deadlines
Placeholder page stating the site is for testing purposes

notes: The ISCTM 2027 Autumn Conference (September 23 to 25, 2027, Barcelona) includes a joint day with ECNP immediately before this congress.
